STEP 26. Check for clogging in the evaporator line from 
hose F.
(1) Remove the fuel tank. (Refer to GROUP 13C, Fuel Tank 
P.13C-6.)
(2) The clogging test with a hand vacuum pump on each hose 
from hose F.
Q: Are there any clogs?
YES : Replace that hose, and perform the OBD-II drive 
cycle P.13B-4.
NO : Go to Step 27.
STEP 27. Check for clogging in the evaporator line hose I, 
L, M, N and hose O.
(1) Remove the filler neck assembly. (Refer to GROUP 13C, 
Fuel Tank P.13C-6.)
(2) The clogging test with a hand vacuum pump on each hose 
from hose I, L, M, N and hose O.
Q: Are there any clogs?
YES : Replace that hose, reinstall the filler neck assembly 
and filler neck protector, and perform the OBD-II drive 
cycle P.13B-4.
NO : Go to Step 28.
